cur = {'r1':'M','r2':'Y','r4':'N','g1':'b','g2':'R','g3':'p','g4':'O'}
tgt = {'r1':'O','r2':'R','r4':'Y','g1':'p','g2':'b','g3':'N','g4':'M'}
# find transposition sequence
import copy
state = dict(cur)
seq=[]
# greedy: use BFS over slot permutations (7! = 5040, fine)
from itertools import permutations
def key(st): return tuple(st[s] for s in slots)
from collections import deque
start=key(state); goal=key(tgt)
# BFS over transpositions of slots
prev={start:None}
q=deque([start])
while q:
    k=q.popleft()
    if k==goal: break
    L=list(k)
    for i in range(7):
        for j in range(i+1,7):
            L[i],L[j]=L[j],L[i]
            nk=tuple(L)
            if nk not in prev:
                prev[nk]=(k,(i,j))
                q.append(nk)
            L[i],L[j]=L[j],L[i]
path=[]
k=goal
while prev[k] is not None:
    k2,ij=prev[k]
    path.append((list(slots)[ij[0]],list(slots)[ij[1]]))
    k=k2
path.reverse()
print('swaps:',len(path))
acts=[{'action':'MOUSE','row':slots[a][0],'col':slots[a][1]} for a,b in path]
acts+=[{'action':'MOUSE','row':slots[b][0],'col':slots[b][1]} for a,b in path]
# interleave properly: do each swap fully before next
acts=[]
for a,b in path:
    acts.append({'action':'MOUSE','row':slots[a][0],'col':slots[a][1]})
    acts.append({'action':'MOUSE','row':slots[b][0],'col':slots[b][1]})
acts.append({'action':'SPACE'})
print(acts)
action(acts[:9])  # up to checkpoint limit 8? keep <=8: 4 swaps=8 clicks
print(last_action_result)
